description: Bookable-offer policy. Config, never code. Navigation is honest by construction: a provider-returned URL is preserved verbatim but only rendered if it passes the scheme+domain allowlist below; a reconstructed search is labelled SEARCH_REPLAY_LINK; a bare hotel/provider page is labelled PROVIDER_LANDING_LINK; anything else is UNAVAILABLE. URLs are never invented and EXACT is never faked.

allowedDomains.domainsNote: Exact host match, https only, no credentials in the URL. A URL that fails the check is DROPPED (the locator degrades to the next honest quality), never 'fixed'. These are the only domains offer navigation may ever point at — a provider-returned URL to anywhere else is treated as data corruption, not as a destination.

freshness.verifiedRecentNote: A verification younger than this renders as 'Verified N min ago'; older verifications and bare observations render their actual age and the UI encourages RECHECK PRICE before booking. No 'still available' language is ever invented.
freshness.observedFreshNote: Observations older than this are flagged as stale evidence in the offer panel.

recheck.staysPerDayNote: Ceiling on xotelo-backed hotel-quote rechecks per day (keyless free API — politeness cap, counted from offer_verifications). Package rechecks spend through the existing package budgets (packages.json caps) — a recheck IS a package search.
recheck.note: A blocked provider ends the recheck immediately with status 'blocked' — no retries, ever. Providers without a resolver return 'unsupported' as a named result, never a guess.
